device_entry.name: 370型多通道交流电阻桥
tags: 低温电阻测量与电阻温度计读出
device_entry.description: 这是一台用于低温实验的多通道交流电阻桥，常见于稀释制冷机系统中。它可对多个通道的电阻进行高灵敏度测量，常用于低温电阻温度计读出以及低温样品电阻测量。
device_entry.description_en: This is a multi-channel AC resistance bridge for low-temperature experiments, commonly used in dilution refrigerator setups. It provides sensitive resistance measurements on multiple channels and is commonly used for cryogenic resistive thermometry readout and low-temperature sample resistance measurements.
